column1: # Rulings on this pair, kept by hand. refuse with both sides: that shape is never a link, whatever proposes it (source: only from that source). refuse with one side and a source: those words leave that source's rows. accept: the shape is pinned and wins every competition.

column6: Христа / Satan: Claude, 2026-10-06: the King James's Satan is the Synodal's сатане at position 2; Христа is Christ.
Иоакима: Matthew 1:11 names Jehoiakim (Eliakim, 2 Kings 23:34; 1 Chronicles 3:15-16), which the translation supplies and KJV does not hold; no word of it renders this one (PRB-0949, PRB-1961)
